turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on word order (subject + verb + object)?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Good idea.

In English the order is: **subject + verb + object**, and time or place goes at the end.
Example: Sam plays football on Fridays.

Now you. Put the words in order:
"plays / Sam / chess / on Mondays"
